instruction: How long is my workout duration today, in minutes, as per my plan in Simple Note?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so every action only asserts knowledge predicates. The workout-plan note is found via simple_note.search_notes with query 'workout' (static fact note-matches), its content is read with show_note, and the duration for today's weekday (Thursday, from the current datetime) is extracted as the answer object workout-duration-today, which is passed to supervisor.complete_task as the answer in minutes. The static answer-in fact links the note to the runtime answer placeholder. supervisor-complete-task is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on all other actions.
